event.description:
Welcome to Asphodel! A music-blessed land, and latest expansion, for the Champions of Grand Archive to explore!

Join us every Thursday for regular games, trying new strategies and picking up new cards, and earning points for the competitive season!

Details:​
Thursdays, 6:30pm start
Entry: $10
Format: Standard Constructed, Swiss rounds, best-of-3

Prizing:
Everyone: Black Promo Packs based on overall placing
Everyone: 1x Grand Archive Booster
